title: Ambient Creatures
description: This mod adds a few friendly mobs to the game that make the world feel more alive and immersive. Includes 3 unique mobs!
body:
![Ambient Creatures Title Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f56fa2593632919a3b2508283f7738b65124623.png)
### **Support The Mod!** [](https://ko-fi.com/R7F720MP5G)
## **About** This mod adds a few mostly passive mobs that are meant to add more ambience and life to the world. Currently there are **3 unique mobs, with more to come!** This mod is also available on [**CurseForge**](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/ambient-creatures) ## **Mobs & Features** Below is a complete list of the mobs added as part of this mod and their current features. ### **Capybara**
Details ![Capybaras Sitting](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a17e7cea230888f97b8c639210ecaf6f4c4d152b_0.webp) ### Overview Capybaras are passive, breedable, and tameable mobs usually found around warmer biomes. They dont really do much, but they're pretty chill B) ### Unique Behaviors Capybaras can be tamed by being fed melon slices. Once tamed, the Capybara will follow the player around similar to other pets. Capybaras can also be made to sit by right clicking on them. ### Spawns Capybaras will spawn naturally in the following biomes - Swamp - Mangrove Swamp - Jungle - Sparse Jungle - Bamboo Jungle - Savanna - Rivers ### Foods ![Capybara Foods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/035bd6c18912762199ec678d1704f7b49b0c35ff.png) Capybaras will be tempted to follow the player and can be bred using the following items - Short Grass - Seagrass - Kelp Capybaras can be tamed using Melon Slices ### Loot Drops If killed, capybaras can drop the following items - Seagrass - Kelp
### **Penguin**
Details ![Penguins on ice](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cfac9c0c03b5c393f8938c38f06ce482fc7a256c_0.webp) ### Overview Penguins are passive, breedable mobs found mainly around very cold biomes. They are able to swim pretty well, and will also sometimes slide around on ice. ### Unique Behaviors Penguins will hunt and kill any fish mobs nearby, and can also pick up and hold fish items in their mouths. After a few seconds, the penguin will eat any fish in their mouths and then continue hunting. ### Spawns Penguins will spawn naturally in the following biomes - Stony Shore - Ice Spikes - Frozen Ocean - Deep Frozen Ocean - Frozen River ### Foods ![Penguin Foods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb6dd7c10646f740a862dfe2aacaef009a60b78d.png) Penguins will be tempted to follow the player and can be bred using the following items - Raw Cod - Raw Salmon - Tropical Fish ### Loot Drops If killed, Penguins can drop the following items - Bone Meal - Feather Penguins will also drop any fish items they are holding in their mouth at the time they are killed.
### **Raccoon**
Details ![Raccoons in the Forest](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/20d5790cbd0b645e289508255e567eb8b1342ed6_0.webp) ### Overview Raccoons are passive, breedable mobs that are usually found around heavily forested biomes. **Raccoons are still currently WIP.** ### Unique Behaviors **Raccoon behaviors are currently WIP, and not feature-complete**, but there are a few planned behaviors coming soon. Raccoons will in the future be able to sleep during the day, steal items from chests, and climb trees. ### Spawns Raccoons will spawn naturally in the following biomes - Forest - Birch Forest - Dark Forest - Flower Forest - Old Growth Birch Forest - River ### Foods ![Raccoon Foods](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ceaf0b8f977472bb4cc2151e8c8b56c1e3c7e5a3.png) Raccoons will be tempted to follow the player and can be bred using the following items - Apple - Bread - Carrot - Potato - Sweet Berries - Egg - Raw Cod - Cooked Cod - Raw Salmon - Cooked Salmon - Raw Chicken - Cooked Chicken ### Loot Drops If killed, Raccoons can drop the following items **(WIP)** - Rabbit's Foot - Rabbit Hide
### **Other Features**
Details ![Spawn Eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/db14d8ca948d7724d4ea6770ca20febde75c2f68.png) ### Spawn Eggs Each mob has their own spawn eggs, which can be found in the creative mode inventory in the spawn eggs tab, or in the tab added specifically for this mod. ### Babies All mobs have unique models and textures for their baby variants (see gallery) to match the style of the recent Tiny Takeover update.
## **Planned Additions** **This mod is currently WIP**, with more mobs and features planned to be added in a future update. Feedback or requests are welcome! (You can comment on the CurseForge page) Below are some of the mobs planned to be added some time soon-ish. - Owls - Crabs - Jellyfish - Raven - Bears - Squirrels - Alligators Raccoons will also have more complex and unique behaviors in a future update. Some mobs, such as the Penguin, will also have skin variants in the future. ## **Known Issues** - Penguins are the only mobs that make sounds. All mobs will have sounds in the full release version - Raccoon behaviors are not complete. They currently only wander around, and can be tempted and bred, similar to most other farm animals. More complex and unique behaviors will come soon. - Mod crashes when trying to run on a server. ## **Check out my other mods!** [](https://modrinth.com/mod/completed-blocksets)
